info.bio: Dance Hall Crashers (a veces abreviado como "DHC") es una banda de ska punk de Berkeley, California, formada en 1988. La banda fue originalmente creada de los miembros de la banda de ska-punk Operation Ivy, menos su cantante y su batería. Ya que Matt Freeman y Tim "Lint" Armstrong estuvieron interesados en tocar con una indumentaria plenamente ska, reclutaron al batería original y entusiasta del ska Erik Larsen alias Erik Kolacek.

scenes.name: Hardcore en la era del punk-pop: emocore, ska-core y post-hardcore
scenes.author: Piero Scaruffi
scenes.desc: Mientras las revistas anuncian la «muerte del punk», el hardcore se convierte en un movimiento que no deja pueblo sin tocar y genera subgéneros. El «emocore» (Jawbreaker, Weezer, Sunny Day Real Estate, Promise Ring, At The Drive-In, Jimmy Eat World, Seaweed); el hardcore progresivo de Washington (Nation Of Ulysses, Make-Up, Shudder To Think, Jawbox, Edsel, Lungfish, Circus Lupus, Dismemberment Plan); el «ska-core» (Operation Ivy, Rancid, Mighty Mighty Bosstones, Sublime, No Doubt); el punk-pop que llega a las listas (Green Day, Offspring, Flop, Pennywise, Pegboy, Superchunk, Queers); el garage-punk californiano (Drive Like Jehu, Rocket From The Crypt, Blink 182, Zen Guerrilla); el jazzcore (Bazooka, Iceburn); la vieja escuela (D Generation, Supersuckers, Zeke, Dropkick Murphys, Silverfish, Turbonegro) y el post-hardcore de Unwound.

podcast.title: Third Wave Ska Band
podcast.body: Dance Hall Crashers was identified as a band from the "third wave" of Ska, which arrived in the 1990s. This wave saw significant popularity with bands like No Doubt, The Mighty Mighty Bosstones, Sublime, Reel Big Fish, and Goldfinger. "Third wave Scott arrived in the 1990s, no doubt, muddy, muddy boss tones, sublime, real big fish, gold finger, dancehall crashes and so many more."

xref.title: Inspiration for "Josie"
xref.body: Elise Rogers, a singer for the Scott Punk band Dance Hall Crashers, owned a dog named Josie, who became the subject of Blink-182's song of the same name. "It's actually about a dog owned by Elise Rogers, one of the singers in the Scott Punk band Dance All Crashers."

xref.title: Third Wave Ska Leader
xref.body: No Doubt was a prominent band in the "third wave" of Ska, which arrived in the 1990s. This wave saw significant popularity with bands like The Mighty Mighty Bosstones, Sublime, Reel Big Fish, Goldfinger, and Dance Hall Crashers. The Interrupters were noted as the first female-fronted Ska band to have a major hit since No Doubt. "Third wave Scott arrived in the 1990s, no doubt, muddy, muddy boss tones, sublime, real big fish, gold finger, dancehall crashes and so many more." "They became the first female fronted Skaban to have a major hit since no doubt."
